summary: Maintain A Resource/Work Center Master For Validated Production Equipm
description: As a Maintenance Planner, I want to maintain a Resource/Work Center Master for validated production equipment, so that Process Orders can only be scheduled on equipment that is currently within its qualification and calibration validity period.
acceptanceCriteria: 1. The user can access the "Manage Work Centers" Fiori app.2. The system captures the equipment's qualification/calibration expiration date on the work center master.3. The system prevents scheduling a process order operation on a work center whose calibration has expired.4. The system generates an alert to Maintenance a configurable number of days before a work center's calibration is due to expire.5. Equipment taken out of service for maintenance is automatically excluded from capacity planning until requalified.6. The batch record references the specific equipment/work center used, including its calibration status at time of use.
